# API Requirements Checklist: Clinic Catalog APIs

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing on clinic catalog methods and seed
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are public-list filters specified for practitioners (active + website flag) and payors (not disabled + website flag)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003/006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are optional specialty/branch filters specified for doctors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Is seed idempotency specified for doctors, payors, branches, and services? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is “bookable branch” defined as a Healthcare Service Unit group that has a parent (root excluded)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are website profile fields on Practitioner listed so Desk and API share the same set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Is Insurance Payor public category’s allowed value set specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do clinic catalog branch/service identity rules stay consistent with booking catalog identity? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/005, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Does “no new top-level catalog DocTypes” still allow Practitioner/Payor field additions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are empty-list responses specified as `[]` with website fallback (not an error page)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is permission bypass for the website role specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is a missing practitioner photo allowed without failing the doctors method? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is re-seed duplicate behavior specified? [Edge Case, Spec §US4 AC3]

## Non-Functional / Auth

- [ ] CHK013 Is guest-without-token success specified for all four catalog methods? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the Desk **Show on Website** flag specified as the public-list gate for practitioners and payors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001/002]
